s');res.innerHTML='';sc.style.display='grid';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,750));const got=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const id=rollArmor();got.push(id);save.inventory.push(id);const a=ARMORS[id],c=document.createElement('div');c.className='summonCard '+RARITY_CLASS[a.rarity];c.innerHTML='<b>'+a.rarity.toUpperCase()+'</b><div style="margin-top:10px">'+a.name+'</div>';res.appendChild(c);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n>3?120:300))}persist();renderInventory();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));sc.style.display='none';toast('Vật phẩm đã vào kho đồ')}
function setupUI(){renderHeroes();$('inventoryBtn').onclick=()=>{renderInventory();$('inventoryModal').classList.add('show')};$('summonBtn').onclick=()=>$('summonModal').classList.add('show');document.querySelectorAll('.close').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>b.closest('.modal').classList.remove('show'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-summon]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>performSummon(+b.dataset.summon));$('resetBtn').onclick=()=>{localStorage.removeItem('mva300');location.reload()};addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const k=e.key.toLowerCase(),first=!KEYS[k];KEYS[k]=1;if(first&&(k===' '||k==='w'||k==='arrowup'))jump();if(first&&k==='1')skill(1);if(first&&k==='2')skill(2);if(first&&k==='3')skill(3);if(first&&k==='e')interact();if(first&&k==='i'){renderInventory();$('inventoryModal').classList.add('show')}});addEventListener('keyup',e=>KEYS[e.key.toLowerCase()]=0);C.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.button===0&&P)attack()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-key]').forEach(b=>{const k=b.dataset.key;b.onpointerdown=e=>{e.preventDefault();KEYS[k]=1};b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=b.onpointerleave=e=>{e.preventDefault();KEYS[k]=0}});document.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach(b=>{b.onpointerdown=e=>{e.preventDefault();({jump,attack,skill1:()=>skill(1),skill2:()=>skill(2),skill3:()=>skill(3),interact}[b.dataset.action]||(()=>{}))()}})}

// v3.01 — dragon relief visual skin for every traversable platform. Collision stays lightweight and unchanged.
const DRAGON_PLATFORM=new Image();DRAGON_PLATFORM.src='data:image/webp;base64,';
const _drawBackgroundV301=drawBackground,_drawPlatformsV301=drawPlatforms;
drawBackground=function(){
  _drawBackgroundV301();
  if(DRAGON_PLATFORM.complete&&DRAGON_PLATFORM.naturalWidth){
    const tileW=280,tileH=36,phase=((cam%tileW)+tileW)%tileW;
    for(let x=-phase-tileW;x<W+tileW;x+=tileW)X.drawImage(DRAGON_PLATFORM,0,0,360,46,Math.round(x),GROUND-3,tileW,tileH);
  }
};
drawPlatforms=function(){
  if(!(DRAGON_PLATFORM.complete&&DRAGON_PLATFORM.naturalWidth))return _drawPlatformsV301();
  for(const p of room.platforms){
    const x=p.x-cam;if(x<=-p.w||x>=W)continue;
    const h=Math.max(44,Math.min(58,Math.round(p.w*.25)));
    X.save();X.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    X.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.22)';X.fillRect(Math.round(x+5),Math.round(p.y+h-6),Math.round(p.w-10),5);
    X.drawImage(DRAGON_PLATFORM,0,0,360,46,Math.round(x),Math.round(p.y-6),Math.round(p.w),h);
    X.restore();
  }
};
loadAssets().then(()=>{setupUI();if(save.hero){$('continueBtn').style.display='inline-block'}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);$('startModal').querySelector('.panel').innerHTML='<h2>Lỗi tải asset</h2><p>Hãy reload trang.</p>'});
})();
</script>
</body></html>
